## CR-CLI-ENTRY-001: Start with the CLI (CRITICAL — Org-Wide)

1. **Start with the CLI (CRITICAL ENTRY GATE)**: When receiving ANY request or starting any task, agents **MUST ALWAYS START WITH THE OPERATOR CLI (`hath0r`)** rather than inventing ad-hoc scripts.
2. **Missing Capability Offer**: If the required connection, MCP, workflow, bot, or factory does not exist in `hath0r`, offer to register the missing capability.
3. **Docs before code**: Require procedure/playbook/runbook before scaffolding implementation.

## Promotion Path (CR-BAI-001)

```text
local → development → testing → staging → master (Production)
```

- Issue first: create an issue before cutting a branch.
- Naming: `feature|bugfix|enhancement|chore/<issue-number>-slug`
- Base PR target: `development`

# SWG Modern Client Architecture Specification (Strategy B)

> **Project:** StarWars-Galaxies-Client  
> **Target Version:** Pre-Combat Upgrade (Publish 14.1)  
> **Language:** Rust (2024 Edition / 1.80+)  
> **Graphics Backend:** `wgpu` (Vulkan on Linux/Windows, Metal on macOS, DX12 on Windows)  
> **Key Crates:** `winit`, `wgpu`, `bevy_ecs`, `kira`, `egui`, `memmap2`, `glam`

---

## 1. High-Level Engine Pipeline

The modern client replaces the legacy 32-bit DirectX 9 pipeline with a modular, data-driven architecture:

```
[OS Window & Events (winit)] ---> [Local Simulation (bevy_ecs)]
                                              |
                   +--------------------------+--------------------------+
                   |                          |                          |
                   v                          v                          v
       [Network Client (tokio)]     [Terrain & Scene Graph]     [UI Engine (egui)]
       - SOE UDP Socket             - Procedural .trn Heights   - Pre-CU Radar & HAM
       - Prediction Buffer          - Skeletal Mesh Blending    - Radial Menus
       - Remote Interpolation       - Clustered Forward+ PBR    - Inventory Windows

# Star Wars Galaxies: Pre-CU Publish 14.1 Mechanics Specification

This document details the exact simulation formulas, rulesets, and design mechanics of Star Wars Galaxies in the **Pre-Combat Upgrade (Publish 14.1 / Spring 2005)** era.

---

## 1. The Tri-Stat HAM Pool & Wound System

Characters have 9 vital attributes grouped into three core pools: **Health**, **Action**, and **Mind** (**HAM**):

| Primary Stat | Secondary Attribute (Drain Cost Reducer) | Tertiary Attribute (Regeneration Rate) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Health** | **Strength** (reduces Health cost on specials) | **Constitution** (accelerates Health regen) |
| **Action** | **Quickness** (reduces Action cost on specials) | **Stamina** (accelerates Action regen) |
| **Mind** | **Focus** (reduces Mind cost on specials) | **Willpower** (accelerates Mind regen) |

### Pool Mechanics:
1. **Current Pool:** Drained when taking damage or executing special combat moves.
2. **Wounds:** Damage can permanently reduce the maximum pool limit until cured by player Doctors/Medics (Health/Action) or Entertainers (Mind).
